decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a new generation of the firm's core marking technology, so its in-house R&D and ink expertise let it interpret results and keep improving the product.

The numbering software module extends the firm's existing software portfolio for variable-data inline printing, so related knowledge makes it easy to assimilate feedback and integrate it with the hardware.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces draws directly on the firm's broad ink and printing expertise, fitting its core competence and its customers' needs.

The mobile decoding app succeeds the earlier PharmaScan app and supports the firm's traceability direction, though it lies further from its machinery core, so the risk of dropping it is somewhat higher.
Inline code verification complements the firm's coding systems and serves its serialization and traceability strategy, which its own R&D can readily build on.
The print layout design software supports common operation across the firm's systems and builds on its established software know-how.
